The trial court on consideration of the evidence on record by judgment and order dated 26th February, 2003 dismissed the suit directing the defendant No. 2 to refund Tk. 25,000/- to the plaintiffs ,within 180 days from the date of judgment in default of 'which,-the-suit stands decreed. "Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree, the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 preferred Other Class Appeal No. 50 of-2003 before the District Judge, Gaibandha which on transfer was heard by the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Gaibandha, who by judgment and order dated 17th July, 2004 allowed the appeal and decreed the suit with a direction upon the petitioner to execute and register a sale deed within 60 days on receipt of Tk. 9,500/-. The petitioner thereupon moved the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 3710 of 2004. A Single Bench of the High Court Division by judgment and order dated 18th May, 2008 discharged the rule and affirmed those of the court of appeal below. 

 5. It is contended on behalf of the petitioner that the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division erred in law in maintains the decree for specific performance in failing to consider that the transaction between the parties is not an agreement for sale of the suit land, rather it is an out and out mortgage and thus the suit as framed is not legally maintainable.
